propositions: Configuration must resolve once per operation boundary with immutable, serializable, non-secret OperationSnapshot following a single precedence order: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default

Provider-native authentication must be injected only through subsystem-local runtime bindings (GitRuntime, LLMRuntime, BridgeRuntime) with SDK-owned credential refresh, and LLM auth must enter exclusively via RP-01's ProviderSession->one-Agent path preserving budget, retry history, cache, exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, and failure translation

Static secrets must be represented as provider-specific non-serializable Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes carriers revealed only in sending adapters, never stored globally or mutated into os.environ, with same-capability children inheriting ambient environment and unrelated siblings removing exact Rebar-declared secret names

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before service creation, copy to a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file permissions, and provide context-local signer bindings without runtime SSM/boto3/region dependency
An in-progress operation must not reread environment, files, cwd, or global config; only repository root resolution may be explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory

A portable AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject reads/reloads/defaults below approved seams, permit only exact path/symbol+rationale exceptions, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover
